options_draft: This document has a draft from {when} that has not been saved yet. The form shows the file saved on disk, without the draft.
rtf_err_url: Use an http:// or https:// address of the running application, without user, password, ? or #, or a project service as service:name:port. Example: http://localhost:8000
rtf_err_path: Use a path relative to the project, without .. and without a drive or a leading slash. Example: api/openapi.yaml
rtf_err_required: Required: without this the check cannot run.
rtf_err_ref: Use a branch, tag or commit name, such as main or origin/main (no spaces, not starting with -).
rtf_err_image: Use a Docker image reference, such as ghcr.io/acme/scanner:2.1.
rtf_missing_note: Missing: fill this in so the check can run.
rtf_lead: Saved in {file}, under {section}. Only what you change here is written; comments and the other keys of the file stay as they are.
rtf_needed: To turn this check on, fill in: {fields}.
rtf_no_start: JGates does not start your application: it only sends requests to the address you give. Start the application (locally or in a disposable environment) before running the validation.
rtf_kept: Kept as they are (edit them in the YAML): {keys}.
rtf_conflict: The file changed since this form was opened. Reload to see the current values, then save again.
rtf_back_review: Back to the review: the plan is built again with this setting
rtf_save_note: Writes only the changed keys to {file}.
rtf_unrecognized_title: Hand-written value the form does not accept
rtf_unrecognized_lead: The form does not change or remove this value. Fix it in the file.
rtf_not_saved: Nothing was saved: {fields} keeps the hand-written value, which the form does not accept. Fix it in the file.
rtf_kept_as_written: {fields} was not changed: it stays as written in the file.
rtf_no_field: This form has no field for {settings}; that setting is edited in the YAML.
